1.consolidated_definition: A la medida. Se dice de lo hecho de acuerdo a especificaciones personales, en particular, ropa hecha expresamente para un cliente. Anglicismo crudo, frecuente. Mínimo de cantidades es requerido para órdenes custom made (Roldán Collection, website, 2007)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Made to measure. Said of something made according to personal specifications, particularly clothing made specifically for a client. Raw anglicism, frequent. A minimum quantity is required for custom-made orders (Roldán Collection, website, 2007)
